system.description:
• Effect: When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).
  • Next to an ally: the extra attack has no Disadvantage against a creature next to one of your allies.
  • Slip away: if that attack hits, your movement this turn doesn't provoke Attacks of Opportunity from that creature.
  • Exploit: still applies to only one attack per round.

activities.name: Cut and Run
activities.text: One additional weapon attack as part of your attack action, with Disadvantage that no Advantage cancels. Slip away: if that attack hits, your movement this turn doesn't provoke Attacks of Opportunity from that creature. Exploit still applies to only one attack per round.

activities.name: Cut and Run (target next to an ally)
activities.text: No Disadvantage on the extra attack against a creature next to one of your allies. Slip away: if that attack hits, your movement this turn doesn't provoke Attacks of Opportunity from that creature. Exploit still applies to only one attack per round.
